name: Approved
description: The payment or authorization was accepted for the requested amount

name: Canceled
description: Processing was stopped before a final successful outcome

name: Declined
description: The payment or authorization was actively refused

name: Failed
description: Processing did not complete because of an error rather than an explicit decline

name: Partially Approved
description: The payment or authorization was accepted for less than the requested amount

name: Pending
description: A final processing outcome is not yet available

name: Reversed
description: A previous approval was undone or released before settlement

name: Unknown
description: The raw result was missing or had no known normalized outcome
